Four isolated variants: SimX and native processor RTL x FP16/BF16; RV64 profiles/p02-tfr.json, one cluster/core, four warps/four threads, issue width one; ordinary dense WMMA tile 8x4x8, KUNROLL=1, C=+0; native TFR tensor and STD scalar floating-point arithmetic, no floating-point DPI substitution, integer DPI support retained. All other format/scaling banks, sparse and WGMMA paths disabled. The exact generated configuration bodies, actual .config.stamp files, 18 role-specific compiler records, matching binary/tool/dependency identities, source inventories and 62 command logs are retained in the four original execution/<variant>/native-packet.zip archives and bound by archive-index.json. The frozen fixture has ten format/case combinations, five per variant, each run twice with distinct destination poison values 0x7fc0dead and 0xdeadbeef. Command budgets: two build jobs, polled 4 GiB process-group RSS, 15 GiB disk reserve, 16 MiB log cap, 1800-second build and 180-second case deadlines.
limitations: Acceptance covers only the frozen synthetic, bias-free batch-16 16-to-8-to-4 MLP, its five case families in FP16/BF16 and two destination poisons. It establishes no arbitrary model loader, trained-model quality, transformer, Python/framework, autograd or training capability.

The accelerated operations are one (16,8,16) and two (8,4,8) native matmuls per model. ReLU, exact conversion, comparison and row assembly are declared host work; native activation/cast support is not established and no CPU matmul fallback qualifies.

Native processor RTL bypasses the AFU. Tensor/scalar floating-point arithmetic uses native TFR/STD datapaths while integer DPI helpers remain. Full AFU integration, vendor hw_emu, physical FPGA and silicon execution are outside this acceptance.

Event and host durations use host steady clocks. Advance includes nested host work, wait intervals overlap event profiles, and clocks from separate jobs are not aligned. Categories cannot be summed into disjoint total cost or interpreted as physical GPU latency, bandwidth, throughput or speedup.

Explicit H2D tensor bytes include destination poison; D2H counts returned tensors. Argument/control staging, module loading, setup traffic and physical DMA transaction counts are excluded. Host assembly bytes are reported separately.

Before/after allocator snapshots bracket tensor operations while the owner/module exists; owner cleanup is checked separately. This is not exhaustive process-heap leak certification or physical-device recovery proof.

Timeouts retain operation ownership. Repeated waits and destruction may drain indefinitely if a backend never completes; the external command monitor supplies the qualification deadline, not bounded device cancellation.

The two-job, 4 GiB process-group RSS, 15 GiB free-disk reserve and 16 MiB command-log limits are polled command budgets, not cgroup or whole-job quotas. Hosted build/case deadlines were 1800/180 seconds; peak samples may miss brief peaks and exclude descendants that deliberately leave the process group.

Main-repository source bodies are checked against the tested Git revision. External submodule source bodies, tool/native binaries and dependency binaries are identified but not fully archived for offline rehash. System headers, dynamic libraries and all transitive tool inputs are not exhaustively inventoried.

Trusted compiler records, byte binding, native reports and hosted metadata establish the declared execution provenance; they do not authenticate arbitrary hardware or a malicious concurrent filesystem writer. Retained-evidence replay does not rerun the native workload.

Earlier preparation failures and the four successful-but-incomplete f4c6a3 packets remain retained as history. Their missing configuration stamps are not reconstructed, and none of those model runs are added to this fresh matrix.

P01-A03 vendor integration remains blocked and required before P07 can close. The inherited tensor DSP area-gate failure, 267 to 283 DSPs against an unchanged 5% bound, remains unresolved; this acceptance changes no RTL, SimX, golden baseline or tolerance and does not claim overall general-CI success.
